'''The Inn on Isttu Lake''' offered comfortable and reasonably priced accommodation in [[Isttu Village]], aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']]. Rooms were charged at twenty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a night. Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]], [[Hanos Darr]] and [[Zaz Kamiroz]], stayed at the Inn.<ref name="GA" />
